_comment: CloudFront Response Headers Policy for SSDT frontend. Apply this policy to your CloudFront distribution's default cache behaviour.
Name: ssdt-security-headers
Comment: Security headers for SSDT React SPA

ContentSecurityPolicy.ContentSecurityPolicy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' https://accounts.google.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com; img-src 'self' data: https:; connect-src 'self' https://api.fortexa.aevus.jp wss://api.fortexa.aevus.jp https://accounts.google.com; frame-src https://accounts.google.com; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; upgrade-insecure-requests;

hashed_assets.reason: CRA names these files with content hashes. Old URLs never resolve after a new deploy so eternal caching is safe.

html_and_root.reason: index.html must always be fresh so users immediately get the latest chunk hashes.

custom_error_responses.reason: S3 returns 403 for paths that don't exist as S3 keys. Returning index.html lets React Router handle the route.

_s3_bucket_policy.note: S3 bucket must block all public access. Grant CloudFront access via Origin Access Control (OAC), not a public bucket policy.

_iam_policy_for_deploy.note: Minimal IAM policy for the GitHub Actions deploy user. Attach to a dedicated IAM user or use OIDC federation (recommended).
